defects.description: POSE NAME belly-up-arms-wide implies supine (belly-up = on back) with arms wide. DESCRIPTION says Curl onto one side with knees drawn up toward the chest and both hands tucked near the face — a side-curl fetal-like pose. Per protocol §4 use INSTRUCTIONS as ground truth (description is king). Library-wide data integrity issue (matches worker-D batch-4 finding of shuffled descriptions in reclining/kneeling sets). Recommend integrator audit name vs description text.

Description: Curl onto ONE SIDE. Current config has NO globalRoll set (defaults to 0). Body is mostly prone-leaning (globalTilt=85) with no side roll — NOT curled onto side. Need globalRoll ±45 for partial side-lying.

Description: knees drawn up toward the chest. Current leftHip=rightHip=20 (mild flexion) and leftKnee/rightKnee default (5°) — knees barely drawn up. Need deep hip flexion (~70°) and deep knee bend (~100°) for fetal-curl knees-to-chest.

Description: both hands tucked near the face. Current leftShoulder=-70 (LEFT arm raised overhead) + rightShoulder=-52 (RIGHT arm raised) + elbows 65/45 — arms extend overhead/out, hands nowhere near face. Need shoulders near 0 (arms at side) + deeper elbow bend (~100°) to bring hands up to face level.

FALSE POSITIVE on sweep knees_to_one_side flag. Description contains the word side (curl onto one side — body orientation, not knees to one side). Knees are at symmetric x=±0.13 (directly below hips in x), not actually to one side. Flag triggered by keyword matching.

failing_tests: description says curl onto side but no globalRoll set
description says knees drawn up toward chest but hip flexion only 20°
description says hands tucked near face but arms raised overhead
sweep knees_to_one_side flag is false positive
regression_risk: medium — significant 10-field rework of pose to match description. Pose name does NOT match description; using description per protocol §4. May read as a near-duplicate of fetal-curl (similar side-curl). Recommend integrator verify rendering and consider renaming pose to match description (e.g. side-curl-hands-to-face) or correcting description to match name.
rationale: Description: Curl onto one side with knees drawn up toward the chest and both hands tucked near the face. Leave a small gap between chin and knees. Current config is for a DIFFERENT pose (arms-wide supine per pose name belly-up-arms-wide) — does NOT match description. Per protocol §4 description is king. Rework to match description: (1) globalRoll 0→-45 (body rolls onto LEFT side, partial side-lying). (2) Knees drawn up: leftHip 20→70, rightHip 20→65, leftKnee default→110, rightKnee default→105 (deep flexion matches fetal-curl convention). (3) Hands near face: leftShoulder -70→0 (LEFT arm comes DOWN from overhead to T-pose), rightShoulder -52→12 (RIGHT arm slightly down, similar to fetal-curl), leftElbow 65→90 + rightElbow 45→90 (deeper bend brings hands UP to face level). (4) spine 0→15 (slight forward curl for fetal position). (5) neck not set (defaults 0, neutral). Sweep knees_to_one_side flag is FALSE POSITIVE — knees are at symmetric x=±0.13 not actually to one side; flag triggered by description keyword side. Rig-limited: no isolated torso twist, no head yaw, hands cannot truly tuck under cheeks without horizontal adduction joint. Approximation only.
